title: Change-Aware Characterization and Early-Warning Prediction of Cascading Service Degradation in Event-Driven Cloud Architectures — Replication Package
description: Source code and recorded synthetic-workload data for the CACDP Study 2 benchmark. Includes the Kafka and HTTP testbed, feature extraction, run-grouped cross-validation, held-out scenario evaluation and file integrity checks. The study1_summary directory contains the 30 tabulated baseline and slowdown run summaries. The reproduce.py entry point checks the queue model and reconstructs the Study 2 outputs.
